scoped_deferred.reason: Indic hyphenation adds external pattern assets and depends on per-character/document language plumbing absent here. Defer with that coordinated language-model change; existing Indic shaping and editing remain.

Per-character BCP47 language storage and language-aware shaping spans 43 files, styles, UI, serialization and import/export. Defer the coordinated model migration, preserving English UI and current Indic shaping.
The newer DocSetup::keep_in_range API and its normalization entry points are absent; no isolated method/test was imported.
Local original-frame recovery already retains verified first baselines and source geometry; the newer planner would require compatibility work rather than replacing this path.
Legacy AI tab-stop import depends on the newer legacy-type reader and paragraph-tab representation; defer together with the later deduplication/layout fixes.
Tab-stop style deduplication depends on the newer legacy AI reader and paragraph structures absent here.
Tab-stop import and right-aligned tab layout span the newer legacy reader, model and layout. Defer as a coordinated chain.
The unicode_char/type.insert code API was introduced by newer work absent here; no matching API changed.
Filled clipping-path import spans the newer style, clipping and mask reader; retain current conservative native-first recovery.
Smooth/corner anchor import spans a newer AI path reader and representation; defer rather than replacing current reader paths.
Default style-sheet import for both character and paragraph runs spans newer sheet parsing and legacy reader APIs; only the independently compatible character inheritance from #4801 is adapted.
Pixelated images require the newer node extras and renderer option absent here; no no-op SVG flag was introduced.
Mutual mask/pattern editing and exit-mode routing touch newer engine/UI enablement contracts across 37 files; defer together.
Stylus pose and multi-sample frame filtering uses a newer canvas input pipeline absent here; the compatible release-position behavior is adapted separately from #5195.

compatibility: Keep native-first AI import, original frames/linked stories and overflow notes, source-overwrite protection, .vcnr identity, English UI, Indic document text and existing Contributors/Models. No new dependency, font, artwork, external pattern asset, contributor registry, publication workflow or upload. Owner instruction-file edits preserved.

verification.build: Optimized-development 0.9.0 native and CLI build pass; actual vectnor-web wasm32-unknown-unknown check passes. Existing unused ask_update_changed warning in unchanged missing_links.rs remains.
desktop: Both supplied AI files open without the Import PDF dialog; missing-font dialogs are cancelled without substituting or changing source text.

Announcement retains ten original text objects and two linked pairs; three-lines retains four point-text objects. Standalone characters, concatenated linked stories and frame geometry match the previous CLI baseline. Font-dependent reflow between linked frames is allowed; the complete story is exact.
Whole-paragraph Type selection, Telugu/ZWNJ insertion, neighboring-frame isolation and exact undo/redo pass.
Native save/reopen retains exact node/thread JSON, both artboard PNG hashes and clean document state.
Three overflow frames reported by normal File Open match current-font area queries; missing fonts remain missing.
Screenshots inspected; isolated native app on port 18008 quit cleanly.
